'''Om'rahk''', a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]], was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force sensitive]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During that time, he accepted the assignment of protecting the village of [[Torosh]] and met the mercenaries [[Nonia Daal|Nonia]] and [[Taelo]].<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Om'rahk appears in the opening story in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Keeping the Peace]]''.<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />
